errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Anteile verschiedener Metalle (Aluminium, Kupfer und Nickel) an den Gesamtproduktionen in Deutschland, der Europäischen Union (EU) und dem Jahr 2021 bis 2023.
errors.evidence: The chart shows the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials (Aluminium, Copper, Nickel) in Germany and the EU, not their share in total production.

errors.evidence: The horizontal axis lists the metals (Aluminium, Copper, Nickel), not the regions or years.
The value for Aluminium in 2023 is 1.0% for Germany and 1.7% for the EU, not 5.1%.
The values for Copper in 2022 and 2023 are 11.3% and 2.2% for Germany, and 5.1% and 1.3% for the EU, not 2.2% and 1.3%.
The value for Nickel in 2023 is 11.4% for Germany and 14.6% for the EU, not 1.7%.
The value for Nickel in 2023 is 11.4% for Germany and 14.6% for the EU, not 25.0%.
The value for Nickel in 2023 is 11.4% for Germany, not 24.7%.
The description does not mention that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials in Germany and the EU.
The description does not mention that the vertical axis represents percentages of Russian imports.
The description does not mention the grouping of bars by year (2021, 2022, 2023) and their color coding (blue, violet, gray).
The description does not mention the two separate charts for Germany and the EU.
